metadata.description: Declared here for the same reason as auth-server's: @nx/js/typescript (Nx 24) infers no `typecheck` target for a project whose @nx/esbuild build type-checks it. Same command shape, inputs and compiler (tsgo) as the inferred targets.

Bundle the migration runner (#474) into dist/apps/migration-runner: one main.js holding the program, pg and drizzle-orm, beside a copy of the generated migrations in drizzle/. The image runs it with Node alone, so it needs no pnpm, nx, tsx or drizzle-kit. `pg-native` stays out: pg loads it only when asked to.

migrate.description: Build the migration runner and run it against DATABASE_URL, from a checkout: `pnpm nx run migration-runner:migrate`, or `-- --check` to report pending migrations and change nothing. Nx reports every failure as exit 1; run `node dist/apps/migration-runner/main.js` for the runner's own exit codes.

test-integration.description: Run the built migration runner against testcontainers Postgres (#474): a fresh database, a second run, two runners at once and --check. Requires a running Docker daemon.
